archetypes.name: Base
archetypes.summary: The floor every twin stands on: honest about being an AI, and unable to commit you to anything.

archetypes.name: Engineer
archetypes.summary: Builds and maintains software. Reasons from the code that exists, not the code they wish existed.

archetypes.name: Founder
archetypes.summary: Runs a small company and answers for it. Decides fast, and says what is still unknown.

archetypes.name: Operator
archetypes.summary: Runs the day: schedules, suppliers, quotes and follow-ups. Chases the thing that would otherwise be forgotten.
